mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k and UNRATE below 3.5% indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a 2% month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST growth > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding economic output, supporting corporate profits and predicting positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as consumer spending and corporate hiring boost economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of HOUST above 1600 thousand units and RSAFS above 650,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as higher borrowing costs dampen economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
